'''Grob'thok'''&mdash;known as '''Grob'thok, Who Feeds the Forge'''&mdash;was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that was altered by the [[Dread Masters]] and put to work in the forges of the [[Dread Fortress]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. During the [[Dread War]] in the [[Galactic War]], Grob'thok was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by invading forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grob'thok appears as the third boss in the Operation "The Dread Fortress," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.4.<ref name="TOR" />
